Our mission is to finance, structure, and mobilize capital for companies and projects that support economic growth, resilience, and long-term development across the region. IDB Invest operates in 26 countries, structured across four geographic regions and three industry verticals: Infrastructure and Energy, Financial Institutions, and Corporates. As part of its evolving business model, “Originate to Share,” IDB Invest is expanding its capacity to mobilize private capital and scale development impact across Latin America and the Caribbean, supported by a $3.5 billion capitalization from its shareholders. The model strengthens IDB Invest’s ability to originate high-quality assets, structure innovative financial solutions, and connect global capital with opportunities across the region. About This Position We are looking to hire a dedicated professional to execute a variety of financial instrument related accounting activities, to support IDB Invest’s Corporate Lending System implementation. You will work in the Accounting part of the Controller’s department. This team is responsible for three primary work streams that include Accounting Policy, Financial Instruments and Systems Solutions, and Financial Reporting and Corporate Accounting. In this role, you will participate in the system implementation activities, including but not limited to system function configuration, business process design, integration with GL and Corporate data warehouse, and data migration validations. What You’ll Do System Implementation work: To support Accounting in all phases of Corporate Lending system implementation, including: Gathering functional requirements and perform business process analysis. Review and validate business requirements, accounting rules, data mappings, and system configurations. Participate in data migration and user acceptance testings. Participate in integration with ERP and downstream reportings, including the general ledger, subledger, Corporate datawarehouse and other relevant systems. Support go-live readiness preparation and post go-live stabilization. Financial Instrument Accounting Work This role is also expected to participate in operational accounting activities, if needed, to support the routine monthly/quarterly/annual financial close in the Accounting function. Ensure financial instruments are accurately accounted for in accordance with US GAAP. Execute operational accounting activities for financial instruments in the development related investment portfolios and/or Treasury portfolios. Prepare monthly/quarterly/annual financial close related supporting schedules and financial statement disclosures utilizing data from various systems, other internal sources and external service providers. What You'll Need Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent advanced degree) in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or other fields relevant to the responsibilities of the role. Professional certification such as CPA or CFA is required. Experience: Two years and above of work experience, preferably working with a financial institution, accounting or consulting firm. Knowledge of financial instruments, especially about Loans and debt instruments, including understanding of end-to-end financial data flows. Experience in implementing Financial Systems with practical applications of accounting standards is a plus. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex accounting requirements into functional system specifications. Languages: Proficiency in English. Knowledge in Spanish is desirable. Requirements Citizenship: Must be eligible to work in job location(s) without the need for sponsorship. Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab. Type of contract and duration Local Remote Consultant: Full-Time, 24 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility) rendered 100% remotely from place of residence of the selected candidate. Services are expected to be provided from a country where the IDB Group has offices. What We Offer The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include: A competitive compensation package. Leave and vacations: 2 days per month of contract + gender-neutral parental leave. Health Insurance: The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance to supplement the purchase of health insurance. Savings plan: The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance. Fully remote modality. Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more. Our culture At the IDB Group, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions. In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process.
